AUTHOR: Zhang
TITLE: A Large Scale Under-Sea Dataset for Marine Observation
VENUE: Global Oceans 2020: Singapore – U.S. Gulf Coast
REGION: SmartBay cabled observatory, Spiddal, Galway Bay, Ireland
DATA: MISSFish: own observatory video (45 annotated videos, 13,946 frames, polygon masks)
V_EV: Sec. III: 'The camera is deployed at 20 meters below the water surface.'
D_EV: no statement found (re-trained FgSegNet reported without any train/test split description)
R_EV: Sec. IV: 'The IoU score of the pre-trained model is 0.080 ... The re-trained FgSegNet model has a slightly better performance (0.109)'
E_EV: Sec. IV: only IoU scores of foreground segmentation reported (FgSegNet 0.080/0.109, GMM 0.186, kNN 0.125)
ARCH: FgSegNet (pre-trained and re-trained), GMM and kNN background subtraction; YOLO/Mask R-CNN and Google Vision AI tried qualitatively
NOTE: Dataset paper with brief pilot experiments. PRE=NR: FgSegNet pre-training on CDnet change-detection benchmark (not an allowed category). R1=Y because off-the-shelf pre-trained FgSegNet (trained on CDnet) is evaluated on MISSFish, and re-trained (in-domain) IoU also reported -> R3=Y; this is a very thin external evaluation. No train/test split described for re-training (D NR). Observatory records turbidity/chlorophyll estimates but none reported. Pre-trained YOLO/Mask R-CNN 'could not detect any under water objects' (no metrics).
